$comment: Registry of every Ed25519 license-signing public key ever embedded in a Lingua build, keyed by RFC 7638 JWK thumbprint. Exactly one entry is active; ordered overlap entries may be pending or retiring until the rollout completes. The release/deploy/CI guard fails closed on undocumented, drifted, stale, duplicate, private, or invalid-status keyrings. Rotation runbook: docs/RELEASE_SECURITY.md § Licensing.

keys.note: Initial production keypair, embedded by implementation (commit 8d2836b8). Retained in LINGUA_LICENSE_PRIVATE_KEY_JWK during the first production rotation compatibility window so existing offline tokens remain valid.

Primary key of the first production rotation, retiring since 2026-10-16. Private half stays in LINGUA_LICENSE_NEXT_PRIVATE_KEY_JWK but no longer signs; its public key keeps verifying existing tokens until they refresh.
Primary key for the second production rotation, promoted on 2026-10-16 after v1.6.1 shipped the three-key keyring. Private half is stored only as LINGUA_LICENSE_PRIVATE_KEY_JWK (current slot).
